MonoBrowser Mobile 0.1.0 - first release

- Minimalist, strictly monochrome and rectangular browser for Android (light and dark), English and Polish
- Tabs and private tabs (separate cookie profile), workspaces, tabs sleep to save memory and survive restarts
- Command palette in the address bar: search, open tabs, bookmarks, history and commands in one place
- Glance: long-press a link for a quick preview; open it as a real tab without reloading
- Built-in ad blocker (adblock-rust) with per-site exceptions, bookmarks with import/export, history, downloads, Markdown notes
- Find in page, pull-to-refresh, address bar at the bottom or the top, per-site camera/microphone/location prompts
- Updates: the app checks this page for new releases (on start and every 6 hours, can be turned off) and installs them only after you tap "Update"

Install: download `MonoBrowser-0.1.0.apk`, open it and allow installing from your browser/file manager when Android asks. Optionally verify it against `MonoBrowser-0.1.0.apk.sha256` (`sha256sum -c`).
Requires Android 8.0 or newer.

Downloads:
- Android: `MonoBrowser-0.1.0.apk` (+ `MonoBrowser-0.1.0.apk.sha256`)
